anchors.description: Width across the front face of the left floral square cushion propped against the headboard wall, from its left edge to its right edge at mid height.
anchors.visible_evidence: Two matching floral cushions stand side by side against the wall behind the bed; the left one shows a full square front face with both side edges and top edge visible.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Could be a 45x45 cm throw cushion or a 50x50 cm decorative pillow; if it is actually a 50x66 cm standard bed pillow used upright, the true width would be near the upper bound.

anchors.description: Length of the dark red bed pillow lying on the comforter, from its left end to its right end at mid height.
anchors.visible_evidence: The red pillow is a long low rectangle in front of the floral cushions, spanning most of the visible bed top with both ends visible.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Standard US pillow 20x26 in assumed; a queen 20x30 in pillow (0.76 m) or a folded throw would shift the length, and the right end sits close to the right floral cushion.

anchors.description: Long edge of the large purple hardcover book lying on top of the floor stack, between its two lower cover corners.
anchors.visible_evidence: A thick purple hardcover with white printed cover text lies on top of the book pile in the lower left, with its lower cover edge spanning the visible face.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Title not legible, so it could be a US letter-size (0.279 m) textbook, a smaller 24 cm trade hardcover, or an oversized art book near 0.33 m.
